note: A Newark mayoral contest was held on May 11, 2010. The Essex County Clerk page View/30 (2010 Non-Partisan Municipal Election, 05/11/2010, last update 04/15/2016) lists 'Mayor Newark' but shows no vote table. It says only 'FOR NEWARK RESULTS GO TO http://www.newarkelection2010.com'. The only known vote source is an Internet Archive copy of that site, which is labeled unofficial and carries QLife branding. It shows Booker 22745 and Minor 13570, but no election authority certifies it. In this pass, the Essex clerk page was read again with a browser user agent through mac2. Requests to web.archive.org (the archived page and the CDX index) timed out with HTTP code 000. The nj.gov 2010 results URLs I tried returned 404. The web search budget is exhausted. No city clerk, county canvass or state document with the totals was found. The year stays unresolved and no result is recorded.
